title: Jubilant Algerian Chicken Burger
description: A bright, tangy chicken burger with a caramelized brown sugar crust, double-fried for crunch, served on a soft bun with a zesty lemon-herb mayo.
instructions: Season the chicken strips with salt, pepper, cumin and coriander.
Whisk the egg and mix the flour, bread crumbs, brown sugar and lemon zest in a shallow bowl.
Dip each chicken strip first in the flour mixture, then in the egg, and finally coat with the breadcrumb mix.
Heat 25ml of olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and pan‑fry the coated strips until golden, about 3 minutes per side.
Remove the strips and pat them dry on paper towels before adding the remaining 25ml olive oil to the skillet.
Double‑fry the strips for another 2 minutes per side to achieve a crunchy caramelized crust.
Toss the fried chicken in a bowl of shredded lettuce, diced tomato and sliced red onion.
Serve the chicken on a toasted bun with a drizzle of lemon‑herb mayo and a squeeze of fresh lemon juice.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
